title: TSP Heuristics (example)
summary: An example algorithm race: find a heuristic that gives shorter Euclidean travelling-salesman tours than the published baselines, at a fixed budget, on instances nobody has seen.

credit.policy: The accepted method's commit and the release notes credit its author; results rows credit who ran them.

review.note: A maintainer reruns the new method on the next beacon round after its PR is frozen, then merges if it beats the current method there.
